dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section terminating in a sharp point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentation visible on the right lateral margin approximately two-thirds down the longitudinal axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; localized thin grey linear streaks primarily oriented longitudinally along the central axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between the faint grey linear marks and the depigmented white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) visible on the central dorsal surface and near the posterior tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible parallel linear scarring (rake marks) concentrated on the mid-dorsal region and the posterior peduncle.
